secondary_lenses: Pass 5 canonical ownership handoff where anchored
Pass 6 Site, role and privacy boundary where anchored
scope.architecture: One operating organisation across multiple Sites; Site access, action permissions, canonical record ownership, direct-object concealment and privacy are the boundaries.

journeys.name: hire-to-first-shift

ordered_handoffs.to: employee profile with primary Site and start date
ordered_handoffs.canonical_owner: RecruitmentService delegates employee creation to EmployeeIntakeService
ordered_handoffs.site_role_privacy: Recruitment and employee-management permissions guard the action; primary_site_id is carried into employee intake.
ordered_handoffs.proof_or_gap: Offer conversion creates the employee through the canonical intake service and marks the candidate hired.

ordered_handoffs.site_role_privacy: The employee retains the intake Site, but checklist creation failure is not transaction-fatal.
ordered_handoffs.proof_or_gap: Checklist creation is attempted after commit; when no active template matches, no checklist is created, the exception is caught and logged, and the hire remains committed.

ordered_handoffs.site_role_privacy: Eligibility checks employment, dates, Site, leave and compliance; global Site scope only broadens visibility and does not supply shift-management permission.
ordered_handoffs.proof_or_gap: No onboarding-checklist completion condition is consulted by shift eligibility.

ordered_handoffs.from: eligible employee selected for a shift
ordered_handoffs.canonical_owner: ShiftLifecycleService for assignment and RosterPublishingService for publication
ordered_handoffs.site_role_privacy: Assignment remains Site-bound and requires roster or shift action permission independently of Site scope.
ordered_handoffs.proof_or_gap: The canonical shift lifecycle assigns the worker and the roster service publishes the period.

ordered_handoffs.from: published shift belonging to the new hire
ordered_handoffs.canonical_owner: AttendanceService once a worker initiates attendance
ordered_handoffs.site_role_privacy: Attendance is anchored to the authenticated worker and canonical shift, but no source test binds the recruitment-created user through this first attendance.
ordered_handoffs.proof_or_gap: Attendance accepts an assigned worker shift in allowed states but does not itself require publication; the specific hire-to-first-attendance thread is not established and is not inherited from J2.

provisional_finding_candidates.title: A newly hired employee can reach assignment eligibility without proven onboarding completion

journeys.browser_task_script_coverage_blocker: No permitted browser or runtime lane executed candidate acceptance, onboarding, roster publication and first clock-in using the same identity.
journeys.completion_test: Accept one Site-bound candidate, complete required onboarding, prove eligibility consumes completion, assign and publish the first shift, then clock in as the same worker under distinct HR, roster and worker roles.

journeys.name: availability-to-published-roster-to-attendance-to-timesheet-to-payroll

ordered_handoffs.canonical_owner: StaffAvailabilityController persists declarations; ShiftStaffEligibilityService applies AvailabilityRule
ordered_handoffs.site_role_privacy: Availability belongs to the worker; these anchors establish availability ownership and evaluation only, not the separate assignment Site or permission boundary.
ordered_handoffs.proof_or_gap: Declared conflicts are evaluated, but missing availability and uncovered windows can remain soft warnings or be overridden rather than forming a hard publication invariant.

ordered_handoffs.site_role_privacy: Canonical shift Site and roster action permission govern assignment and publication.
ordered_handoffs.proof_or_gap: The assignment is persisted through the shift lifecycle and included in the published period.

ordered_handoffs.from: assigned worker shift in an attendance-eligible state; publication is not enforced here
ordered_handoffs.site_role_privacy: The authenticated worker and canonical assigned shift constrain clock-in; Site scope does not replace attendance capability.
ordered_handoffs.proof_or_gap: Clock-in creates the attendance session against the authenticated worker's assigned shift in an allowed state; this edge does not prove a publication precondition.

ordered_handoffs.canonical_owner: AttendanceService delegates draft creation and reconciliation to DraftTimesheetService
ordered_handoffs.site_role_privacy: Timesheet identity, worker, shift and Site are derived from canonical attendance and shift records.
ordered_handoffs.proof_or_gap: Clock-out invokes canonical draft-timesheet materialization.

ordered_handoffs.to: payroll-run source and later bank-accepted net-pay settlement
ordered_handoffs.canonical_owner: PayrollExportService owns payroll-run sources; ExternalSettlementService owns bank-accepted net-pay settlement
ordered_handoffs.site_role_privacy: Manager approval and payroll execution require their own actions; payroll sources retain canonical shift and timesheet Site context.
ordered_handoffs.proof_or_gap: Approved in-period timesheets are selected as payroll-run sources; after bank acceptance, the separate settlement service records net-pay settlement and marks the run timesheets paid.

provisional_finding_candidates.title: Publication-time roster validation does not demonstrate linkage to the persisted eligibility-override reason and warning record

journeys.browser_task_script_coverage_blocker: Static tests were located but not executed; no role-driven worker, manager and payroll-admin browser script was permitted.
journeys.completion_test: Declare availability, roster and publish, clock in/out, submit and independently approve the generated timesheet, then include and settle it in one payroll run with Site and direct-object denials tested separately.

journeys.name: client-intake-to-plan-to-shift-task-to-note-or-outcome

ordered_handoffs.site_role_privacy: Workflow queries are constrained by approved Sites and Client access; action permissions remain required.
ordered_handoffs.proof_or_gap: The controller owns workflow steps and explicit completion for the canonical Client.

ordered_handoffs.from: care-plan creation submitted with from_onboarding during an in-progress Client onboarding workflow
ordered_handoffs.to: completion of the matching incomplete Care Plan Created onboarding step
ordered_handoffs.site_role_privacy: Care-plan creation is anchored to the accessible Client and its Site.
ordered_handoffs.proof_or_gap: Only the from_onboarding path, while the workflow is in progress and the exact-name Care Plan Created step is still incomplete, completes that onboarding step.

ordered_handoffs.canonical_owner: No canonical cross-module owner found; ShiftTaskController owns standalone shift tasks
ordered_handoffs.site_role_privacy: Task mutation checks action capability, worker ownership unless manageAny, and task-to-shift identity; these anchors do not establish a canonical Site boundary, and ShiftTask has no care-plan or goal identity.
ordered_handoffs.proof_or_gap: ShiftTask contains shift, label, schedule and completion data but no Client, care-plan, goal, intervention or outcome foreign key.

ordered_handoffs.canonical_owner: ClientNoteController owns shift-linked notes; CarePlanGoalController independently owns goal notes and progress
ordered_handoffs.site_role_privacy: Client notes validate the shift and Client relationship, while goal notes use the care-plan hierarchy; neither can authorize the other by adjacency.
ordered_handoffs.proof_or_gap: Independent shift-linked note and goal-progress capabilities exist, but neither binds to the completed ShiftTask; the completed-task-to-note-or-outcome handoff is therefore not established.

provisional_finding_candidates.title: Care-plan interventions lack canonical lineage through assigned shift tasks to worker evidence and outcomes

journeys.browser_task_script_coverage_blocker: No permitted task script created a goal-driven shift task and traced its completion into a client note and reviewed outcome.
journeys.completion_test: Create a Site-authorized Client, create a care-plan goal, generate a ShiftTask carrying immutable goal or intervention identity, complete it as the assigned worker, and display an auditable task-to-note-to-outcome chain.

journeys.name: prescription-to-stock-to-round-to-administration-error-review

ordered_handoffs.site_role_privacy: Medication stock carries Client and medication identity, but these anchors do not prove Site-safe access or order-lifecycle materialization.
ordered_handoffs.proof_or_gap: The canonical medication exposes an optional stock relation and stock records retain medication identity; these anchors do not prove that the order lifecycle materializes a stock aggregate.

ordered_handoffs.site_role_privacy: Round access is Client and Site sensitive, but the round aggregate does not persist immutable per-order membership.
ordered_handoffs.proof_or_gap: A round is generated and medication candidates are queried dynamically; no immutable round-item snapshot binds the verified order version.

ordered_handoffs.site_role_privacy: The administrator must be authorized for Client, medication and Site; administration stores medication_round_id.
ordered_handoffs.proof_or_gap: The guided-round action invokes the canonical MAR service and binds administration to the round.

ordered_handoffs.to: controlled-drug register entry and, when stock.on_hand is non-null, a clamped stock-balance update
ordered_handoffs.site_role_privacy: The conditional stock mutation occurs inside the authorized medication-administration transaction and canonical Client medication context.
ordered_handoffs.proof_or_gap: The service always creates the controlled-drug register entry; when stock exists and on_hand is non-null it assigns max(0, before minus quantity), so no positive decrement is claimed for a zero balance.

ordered_handoffs.site_role_privacy: MedicationError carries client_id and optional client_medication_id, but these anchors do not establish that the medication belongs to that Client or that direct-object access is Site-scoped.
ordered_handoffs.proof_or_gap: MedicationError links to Client medication and optionally an incident, but has no administration_id.

ordered_handoffs.site_role_privacy: Routes require medications.administer.correct or clients.update, but the cited direct-bound review and resolve actions do not establish canonical Client/Site access; Site-safe direct-object review and resolution are NOT_ESTABLISHED.
ordered_handoffs.proof_or_gap: MedicationError has its own lifecycle; separate MedicationReview medications_reviewed JSON is not inherited as error lineage.

provisional_finding_candidates.title: Medication errors cannot be traced to the exact administered dose
Medication-round membership lacks an immutable verified-order snapshot

journeys.browser_task_script_coverage_blocker: No permitted runtime round was generated, administered, stock-reconciled, deliberately errored and reviewed end to end.
journeys.completion_test: Bind an immutable verified order version to a round item, administer it, prove stock movement references administration, create an error referencing the same administration, and independently review and close it.

journeys.name: incident-or-hazard-to-investigation-to-corrective-action-evidence-verification

ordered_handoffs.canonical_owner: IncidentJourneyService creates handover; HsEventController accepts it
ordered_handoffs.site_role_privacy: Incident and H&S event retain canonical Site; incident review and H&S acceptance are separate capabilities.
ordered_handoffs.proof_or_gap: IncidentJourneyService materializes the H&S event and exposes handover acceptance.

ordered_handoffs.from: open H&S event, whether or not handover acceptance occurred
ordered_handoffs.site_role_privacy: Investigation is tied to canonical H&S event Site and investigation permission.
ordered_handoffs.proof_or_gap: The service creates and governs investigation from an open H&S event, but it does not inspect handover acceptance; accepted-handover-to-investigation sequencing is not established.

ordered_handoffs.from: completed and approved investigation recommendation, with accepted handover when incident-backed
ordered_handoffs.site_role_privacy: The action inherits investigation and event Site; assignment does not bypass corrective-action permission.
ordered_handoffs.proof_or_gap: Only a completed investigation can materialize its approved recommendation as a governed corrective action, and incident-backed events must also have an accepted handover; review alone is not sufficient.

ordered_handoffs.site_role_privacy: Evidence mutation is constrained by action ownership, H&S permission and Site.
ordered_handoffs.proof_or_gap: Completion and governed evidence operations are explicit.

ordered_handoffs.site_role_privacy: Independent verification is distinct and the controller binds the verifier to the authenticated user after accessible-event resolution; exact wrong-Site denial for this corrective-action verification/closure handoff remains NOT_ESTABLISHED by these anchors.
ordered_handoffs.proof_or_gap: Verification and closure are separate governed transitions after completion.

ordered_handoffs.to: the same H&S investigation and corrective-action assurance chain
ordered_handoffs.canonical_owner: SiteHazardController and SiteHazardAction form a parallel owner
ordered_handoffs.site_role_privacy: Hazard register is Site-bound, but adjacent Site ownership cannot establish HsEvent, Investigation or CorrectiveAction lineage.
ordered_handoffs.proof_or_gap: No source bridge was found into the canonical H&S investigation and independent-verification chain.

provisional_finding_candidates.title: Hazard-register actions do not reach the canonical independent investigation and corrective-action assurance chain

journeys.browser_task_script_coverage_blocker: No permitted role-driven script compared incident-originated and hazard-originated assurance through final verification.
journeys.completion_test: Submit an incident and Site hazard, prove each enters canonical H&S investigation, create actions and evidence, reject self-verification and wrong-Site access, then independently verify closure.

journeys.name: purchase-to-asset-device-vehicle-to-maintenance-depreciation-disposal

ordered_handoffs.from: purchase-order line; a goods-receipt transition is itself not established
ordered_handoffs.to: operational Asset, Device or vehicle identity
ordered_handoffs.canonical_owner: PurchaseOrderController owns procurement; no canonical procurement-to-register owner found
ordered_handoffs.site_role_privacy: Procurement and registers have separate permissions and Site contexts; shared descriptions or serials do not establish ownership.
ordered_handoffs.proof_or_gap: The line exposes received_quantity, but the bounded source search did not establish a goods-receipt mutation path, an Asset/Device/vehicle foreign key, or a canonical register-creation handoff.

ordered_handoffs.site_role_privacy: Model carries Asset identity; controller list/options/direct-write Site and policy boundaries require separate scrutiny.
ordered_handoffs.proof_or_gap: Operational Asset exposes work orders and the controller creates maintenance records against it.

ordered_handoffs.site_role_privacy: The cited service proves duplicate-active-pair prevention and link creation only; Asset and Device Site compatibility, authorization, and Site-safe custody semantics are NOT_ESTABLISHED by these anchors.
ordered_handoffs.proof_or_gap: An explicit service binds canonical Device identity to Asset identity. This classification does not award Site compatibility, authorization, or custody-boundary proof.

ordered_handoffs.canonical_owner: AssetValueObserver delegates selective capture to FixedAssetService
ordered_handoffs.site_role_privacy: Site is available from Asset; financial category and threshold rules determine capture.
ordered_handoffs.proof_or_gap: Observer registration and capture are proven, but no normal AssetValue creation path was located; capture is selective and observer failure is logged.

ordered_handoffs.site_role_privacy: Finance action permission controls depreciation; financial asset retains source identity.
ordered_handoffs.proof_or_gap: The service calculates and records depreciation with source-anchored integrity tests.

ordered_handoffs.to: operational Asset, Device and vehicle retirement
ordered_handoffs.canonical_owner: FixedAssetService owns financial disposal; operational retirement and DeviceLinkService unlink remain separate
ordered_handoffs.site_role_privacy: Finance disposal permission cannot implicitly authorize fleet retirement or device unlinking.
ordered_handoffs.proof_or_gap: Financial disposal updates fixed asset and journal but does not retire operational Asset/vehicle, unlink Device or resolve maintenance.

provisional_finding_candidates.title: No canonical goods-receipt-to-Asset, Device or vehicle register provenance is established; the receipt mutation itself is also not established
Financial disposal does not terminalize operational Asset, Device, vehicle and maintenance projections
Fleet work-order controller paths lack an established per-record Site and direct-object authorization boundary

journeys.browser_task_script_coverage_blocker: No permitted task received a PO, registered the same item operationally and financially, maintained, depreciated and disposed of all projections.
journeys.completion_test: Receive one serialized PO line into a canonical Asset, bind Device/vehicle projections, close maintenance, create depreciation, then dispose and terminalize all projections with foreign-Site IDs concealed.

journeys.name: telemetry-to-signal-to-alert-to-incident-or-work-order-to-closure

ordered_handoffs.site_role_privacy: Downstream signal projection resolves canonical Device Site; collector authentication and ingress scope are NOT_ESTABLISHED by these anchors.
ordered_handoffs.proof_or_gap: The observer suppresses heartbeat events, persists an outbox for the remaining already-created DeviceEvents, and the job owns retryable delivery.

ordered_handoffs.from: routable signal outbox whose Device resolves to one canonical active Site
ordered_handoffs.canonical_owner: DeviceEventObserver builds payload; DispatchDeviceEventSignalOutbox delivers it
ordered_handoffs.site_role_privacy: Observer resolves canonical Device Site and rejects adjacent projection ownership; unroutable or ambiguous Site resolution does not produce this signal edge.
ordered_handoffs.proof_or_gap: A routable outbox delivers a signal payload with canonical Site and Device context; the unroutable branch records SafetySignalUnroutable instead.

ordered_handoffs.from: pending non-online control-room signal outside a maintenance window
ordered_handoffs.site_role_privacy: Alert consumes canonical signal Site; online events use recovery handling and maintenance-window signals are suppressed rather than inheriting this edge.
ordered_handoffs.proof_or_gap: Eligible pending signals either reconcile or correlate to a canonical existing alert or, after applicable monitor-rule evaluation, create a new alert; online and maintenance branches are deliberately excluded.

ordered_handoffs.from: authorized operator create-incident action or confirmed detection/sensor alert
ordered_handoffs.site_role_privacy: Bridge preserves alert and Device Site; control-room and incident permissions remain distinct.
ordered_handoffs.proof_or_gap: The explicit authorized controller action and confirmed detection/sensor branch create or link the incident through the canonical journey; arbitrary alerts do not automatically inherit this edge.

ordered_handoffs.site_role_privacy: Shared Asset/Device Site cannot authorize or establish maintenance without Fleet work-order capability and an explicit bridge.
ordered_handoffs.proof_or_gap: Bounded ControlRoom source search found no FleetWorkOrder creation path; incident semantics cannot be inherited as maintenance semantics.

ordered_handoffs.site_role_privacy: Closure requires alert action authority and canonical linked-state checks; visibility alone does not confer closure.
ordered_handoffs.proof_or_gap: Lifecycle requires terminal alert tasks and linked incident/H&S closure before alert closure.

provisional_finding_candidates.title: Telemetry maintenance alerts lack a canonical Fleet work-order handoff

journeys.browser_task_script_coverage_blocker: No real collector event, outbox worker, signal processor, alert operator, incident reviewer and maintenance owner were executed.
journeys.completion_test: Ingest one authenticated DeviceEvent, persist/retry outbox, create Site-bound signal and alert, exercise incident and explicit work-order branches, and deny closure until all linked work is terminal.

journeys.name: service-agreement-or-funding-to-delivery-to-claim-or-invoice-to-GL
journeys.identity_coverage_note: No dedicated current matrix ID was determinable for the service-agreement lifecycle.

ordered_handoffs.site_role_privacy: Client and Site binding is explicit, but submit and approve use the same service_agreements.update permission and do not establish independent approval.
ordered_handoffs.proof_or_gap: Store/update can accept active status, generic transition accepts lifecycle changes, and approval lacks demonstrated segregation of duties.

ordered_handoffs.from: approved delivered timesheet with a positive eligible Client allocation
ordered_handoffs.site_role_privacy: BillingEntry derives Client, shift and Site from approved delivery; service_agreement_id may be null and is not inferred as mandatory authority by this edge.
ordered_handoffs.proof_or_gap: Approval invokes canonical BillingEntry generation for positive eligible Client allocation; it does not require an agreement record for every entry.

ordered_handoffs.from: eligible unconsumed BillingEntry under an active canonical ServiceAgreement and line item
ordered_handoffs.site_role_privacy: Claim selection and direct access are Site-scoped; eligibility also binds Client, Site, delivery date/state, active agreement and line item before retaining BillingEntry provenance.
ordered_handoffs.proof_or_gap: The service binds only eligible snapshot-complete delivery entries to claim items and serializes claim-versus-invoice consumption.

ordered_handoffs.from: eligible unconsumed pending/approved BillingEntry set for one active-Site Client
ordered_handoffs.site_role_privacy: Invoice retains Client, Site and service provenance and requires finance billing authority.
ordered_handoffs.proof_or_gap: BillingService locks a complete eligible set and materializes FinInvoice/lines; the source test proves legacy App Models Invoice is not owner.

ordered_handoffs.from: submitted FundingClaim whose queued or retried posting job completes successfully
ordered_handoffs.site_role_privacy: Claim submission permission and canonical claim Site access precede finance posting; the job posts from canonical claim identity.
ordered_handoffs.proof_or_gap: Submission durably records queued and possible failed/retry state; only a successfully completed idempotent posting job creates the source-bound journal.

ordered_handoffs.site_role_privacy: Invoice-send and GL posting are finance actions on canonical Site-bound FinInvoice.
ordered_handoffs.proof_or_gap: Sent status commits before job dispatch; unlike FundingClaim, FinInvoice has no demonstrated durable queued/failed/retry state, so interruption can strand sent invoice without GL.

provisional_finding_candidates.title: Service agreements can become active without a proven independent approval boundary
FinInvoice can reach sent state without durable assurance that its GL job was dispatched or recoverable

journeys.browser_task_script_coverage_blocker: No permitted role-separated agreement approval, delivered shift, timesheet approval, claim/invoice creation and GL reconciliation was executed.
journeys.completion_test: Require independently approved Site-bound agreement, approve delivery into BillingEntry, prove mutually exclusive claim/invoice consumption, post each branch exactly once to GL, recover dispatch failure and reconcile provenance.

collisions_and_duplicates.collision: Both traverse shift assignment and roster publication.
collisions_and_duplicates.adjudication: J1 asks whether recruitment/onboarding reaches a first shift; J2 begins with availability and follows an operational shift into payroll. J2 attendance evidence does not repair J1's missing new-hire identity thread.

PayrollExportService owns payroll-run source materialization, ExternalSettlementService owns bank-accepted net-pay settlement, and BillingService owns revenue/funding materialization. None supplies another owner's completion semantics.

collisions_and_duplicates.collision: Both can enter IncidentJourneyService and H&S corrective-action state.
collisions_and_duplicates.adjudication: J5 evaluates investigation assurance; J7 telemetry/control-room orchestration. Incident bridge does not establish alert-to-FleetWorkOrder.

collisions_and_duplicates.collision: Asset, Device and FleetWorkOrder are adjacent to telemetry alerts.
collisions_and_duplicates.adjudication: J6 proves explicit Asset work-order and Device-link actions. J7 cannot inherit work-order creation from Device/Asset origin.

collisions_and_duplicates.collision: SiteHazardAction and HsCorrectiveAction are parallel owners.
collisions_and_duplicates.adjudication: Site and purpose similarity do not establish hazard-to-HsEvent-to-Investigation-to-CorrectiveAction lineage.

collisions_and_duplicates.collision: MedicationError review and MedicationReview are parallel concepts.
collisions_and_duplicates.adjudication: MedicationErrorController owns error resolution; MedicationReview JSON cannot be inherited as exact error/administration review.

collisions_and_duplicates.collision: ShiftTask, ClientNote and care-plan goal progress share shift or Client context.
collisions_and_duplicates.adjudication: They lack immutable task-to-note-to-goal identity, so adjacency does not prove outcome lineage.

collisions_and_duplicates.collision: App Models Invoice and Domain Finance FinInvoice are duplicate concepts.
collisions_and_duplicates.adjudication: BillingService canonically writes FinInvoice; tests/Feature/Finance/OperationsBillingServiceFinInvoiceTest.php:48-57 proves legacy Invoice is not populated.

collisions_and_duplicates.collision: Canonical SecurityDevices Device and a ControlRoom Device projection coexist.
collisions_and_duplicates.adjudication: app/Observers/DeviceEventObserver.php:117-132 guards canonical Device/Site projection; projection identity cannot replace ownership.

collisions_and_duplicates.collision: ServiceAgreement active state has direct create, update, generic transition, submit and approve paths.
collisions_and_duplicates.adjudication: Competing lifecycle paths do not demonstrate an independently authorized activation gate.

cross_review.completion_test_result: PASS for source reconstruction schema; FAIL or NOT_ESTABLISHED for runtime and browser completion because execution was prohibited.

zero_credit_attestation.attestation: No upstream project was selected or mapped, static tests were source anchors only, and no browser, network, runtime, build, database or test execution was performed.
